cases.sentence: Сын — сияние славы Отца, ___ самой сущности Бога.
cases.explain: «точное подобие» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

cases.sentence: Сын поддерживает существование всей вселенной Своим ___.
cases.explain: «могущественным словом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

cases.sentence: Разве ангелы — это не ___, посылаемые на службу тем, кому предстоит получить спасение?
cases.explain: «служебные духи» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
